rationale.trigger: The prospectively locked v1.5 extension falsified the broader four-cell conditional-support claim: six invalid accepted average-of-8 by 16-pixel tensor-coherence measurements occurred in two of seven untouched WideField_BPAE_R fields.
rationale.repair: All nineteen non-excluded WideField_BPAE_R fields were then used only for development. A conservative profile retained the three average-of-16 cells with zero accepted failures in every field.
rationale.external_test: Apply that three-cell profile without refitting to two unopened FMD archives that vary one axis at a time: the same mitochondrial channel on a confocal microscope and the same widefield microscope on an F-actin channel.
rationale.confirmation_status_at_lock: The archive files were downloaded and checksum-verified, but selected image pixels had not been decoded for measurement analysis when this protocol was frozen.

scope.claim: A conservative three-cell acquisition-by-scale support profile developed on widefield mitochondrial images can be tested without refitting across a different microscope with the same channel and a different structural channel with the same microscope.
excluded_claims: universal transfer to arbitrary microscopes, tissues or channels
physical-scale measurement because FMD does not provide pixel spacing

selection.source_rule: Use Confocal_BPAE_R for same-channel/different-instrument transfer and WideField_BPAE_G for same-instrument/different-structure transfer.
selection.field_rule: Within each dataset key, sort FOV identifiers 1-20 by SHA-256(seed|dataset_key|fovN) and take the first seven.
selection.realization_rule: Within each selected field, sort realization indices 0-49 by SHA-256(seed|dataset_key|fovN|realizationK) and use the four smallest hashes at every acquisition level.

source.reference_definition: One avg50.png reference per field of view.
source.nested_unit: four hash-selected repeated noise realizations per level within a field of view

source.reference_definition: One avg50.png reference per field of view.
source.nested_unit: four hash-selected repeated noise realizations per level within a field of view

uncertainty.interpretation: The exact field-event interval treats the selected FOV as the independent unit. Pixel, endpoint and repeated-realization counts are nested observations and are not promoted to independent samples.
